from pyspark.sql.functions import col, current_timestamp,when, year, month

# Definição dos Caminhos no ADLS Gen2
path_bronze_vh = "abfss://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/vehicle/2. BRONZE"
path_silve_vh =  "abfss://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/vehicle/3. SILVER "
path_checkpoint = "abfss://telemetria@stlogitrackdevbrazsouth.dfs.core.windows.net/vehicle/_checkpoints/silver_vehicle"

# Leitura Incremental da Bronze
df_bronze_vh = (
    spark.readStream
    .format("delta")
    .load(path_bronze_vh)
                     )



# Tratamento, Deduplicação e Regras de Negócio (Bronze -> Silver)

df_silver_vh = (
        df_bronze_vh
        .drop("data_ingestao","arquivo_origem")
        .withColumn("dt_corrent_silver", current_timestamp())
        .filter(col("vehicle_id").isNotNull())
        .withWatermark("timestamp"," 2 hours")
        .drop_duplicates(["vehicle_id", "timestamp"])
        .withColumn("ano", year(col("timestamp")))
        .withColumn("mes", month(col("timestamp")))
        .withColumnRenamed("speed","velocidade")
        .withColumnRenamed("fuel_level","nivel_combustivel_pct")
       

        .withColumn(
            "status_velocidade",
            when(col("velocidade") > 90.0, "2")
            .when(col("velocidade") == 0.0, "3")
            .otherwise("1")
            )
        .withColumn(
            "status_combustivel",
            when(col("nivel_combustivel_pct")< 15.0, "2")
            .otherwise("1")
        )
)

# Tabela transformada enviada para silver
spark.sql("create database if not exists silver" )

query_vh = (
     df_silver_vh.writeStream
    .format("delta")
    .outputMode("append")
    .option("checkpointLocation", path_checkpoint)
    .option("path", path_silve_vh)
    .option("mergeSchema","true")
    .partitionBy("ano","mes")
    .trigger(availableNow=True)
    .toTable("silver.tb_vh")

)
query_vh.awaitTermination()
